summary: Keeps content inside the device safe area, and re-applies on rotation.
overview: Drop it on a full-stretch RectTransform, usually a direct child of the Canvas, and it keeps content clear of notches, rounded corners and the home indicator. It re-applies automatically when resolution or orientation changes.
useCases: Any phone build with a notch or rounded corners.
Handling rotation without a second layout.
Keeping controls away from the home indicator.

gotchas.title: Put it on a container, not on each element
gotchas.body: It adjusts the RectTransform it is on. One safe-area container with your UI inside is the pattern; one per element fights itself.

gotchas.title: The Editor reports a full-screen safe area
gotchas.body: So it looks like it does nothing until you run on a device or use a device simulator.
